title: Marble Mayhem
intro.text: Every colour sends {n} marbles into the race. Before each race you secretly build parts into the track – then everything rolls from top to bottom.
intro.r1: Green helpers only work for your colour: flywheel, spring flap, magnet, glass dome.
intro.r2: Red traps hit every other colour: honey, barrier, bumper, trapdoor, fan, brushes.
intro.r3: Yellow flaps, pneumatic tube and catapult can be flipped live on your phone during the race.
intro.r4: Every part has a colour sensor in front – it knows whose marble is coming. Blue events hit everyone, and the track changes every round.
intro.points: {total} rounds · every marble in the goal scores by place · +100 for the first marble · +20 per foreign marble caught
build.title: Build secretly now!
build.text: Pick 2 of 3 parts on your phone and place them on free spots. If two want the same spot, whoever is further behind gets it.
build.textLast: Last round: place all 3 parts – and all points count double.
reveal.title: This got built
d.farbweiche: flap open only for you or only for others
d.umleitung: flap open or closed for all
phone.intro: Your colour – you have {n} marbles. Look at the TV.
phone.pickSocket: Now tap a glowing spot on the track.
phone.allPlaced: All placed. Tap a part to take it back.
phone.legend: Dashed = free spot · faded = from last round · you can't see what others build. Drag the plan with your finger.
phone.mapHint: Big = your marbles, A/B = your parts to flip
phone.noToggles: Nothing to flip – just watch and cheer!
tg.farbweiche.on: Open just for you – yours drop a row
tg.farbweiche.off: Open for everyone else – only you roll on
tg.kanone.on: On: throws every marble far ahead
umbau.title: The track changes
umbau.added: Row {row}: there's now a {to} at the end.
umbau.removed: Row {row}: the end is open now.
umbau.wear: Row {worn} got a dent (slows down), row {polished} is polished (rolls better).
umbau.items: Parts from this race last one more race, weaker.
